item.text: {"actions":[{"action":"Trace edits through theme-specific token dependencies","mechanism":"Resolve reverse dependencies per brand and theme, stopping at explicit overrides and reporting cycles rather than guessing values.","implementation":"Build a dependency graph; stage base edits and list changed resolved tokens with alias paths. Mark cyclic paths unresolved.","check":"Test a multi-level alias and a cycle; verify propagated values and termination. Confirm an overriding brand value remains unchanged.","risk":"A single global graph could misrepresent brand-specific resolution."},{"action":"Evaluate actual foreground/background uses","mechanism":"Check rendered pairs by usage context, not token name, because one token can serve multiple roles.","implementation":"Index pairs by component, state, brand, and theme. Recalculate affected pairs against configured contrast requirements; flag failures and unevaluable compositions.","check":"Use one token as text and background in separate pairs. Verify both affected uses appear with independently calculated results.","risk":"Color checks alone do not establish complete accessibility."},{"action":"Keep brand differences explicit and traceable","mechanism":"Attach provenance to resolved values so intentional overrides remain distinguishable from inherited values throughout editing.","implementation":"Show each value’s source, override rationale, and alias chain. Require an explicit brand-scoped operation to change or remove an override.","check":"Edit the shared base and verify override values and provenance persist. Explicitly removing an override must reveal the inherited source.","risk":"Missing rationales can leave intentional differences difficult to interpret."},{"action":"Compare current and proposed values without color","mechanism":"Use labeled numeric differences and textual status alongside paired previews, making downstream changes understandable without swatch discrimination.","implementation":"Provide a searchable comparison table with token paths, brand/theme, current/proposed values, pair contrast ratios, and written change or review labels.","check":"Hide swatches and verify designers can identify changed values, affected pairs, unchanged overrides, and unresolved cases from text alone.","risk":"An ungrouped 180-token table could obscure consequential changes."},{"action":"Gate publishing on a versioned pair-review report","mechanism":"Bind review decisions to exact proposed values so subsequent edits cannot reuse stale approvals.","implementation":"Before publishing, list affected failing or unevaluable pairs and baseline failures separately. Require correction or an explicit, recorded policy-permitted exception; invalidate decisions when inputs change.","check":"Approve a proposal, modify a relevant background, and attempt publishing. Confirm the changed pair requires renewed review.","risk":"Permissive exceptions can normalize illegible combinations."},{"action":"Offer constrained repairs instead of broad replacement","mechanism":"Search for nearby color adjustments satisfying affected pair requirements while treating brand overrides as locked constraints.","implementation":"Offer opt-in patches to the base or an explicit semantic token. Show each candidate’s full downstream diff; report when no feasible candidate exists.","check":"Create conflicting text/background requirements. Verify infeasibility is reported rather than silently unlocking overrides or accepting a failing candidate.","risk":"Numerically valid repairs may still undermine intended visual hierarchy."},{"action":"Publish and restore palettes as atomic versions","mechanism":"Keep aliases, overrides, and review evidence together so partial updates cannot produce unreviewed foreground/background combinations.","implementation":"Stage the full palette snapshot, validate its review report, and atomically activate that version. Retain the prior snapshot for explicit rollback.","check":"Interrupt publishing midway and verify consumers retain one complete version. Roll back and confirm alias resolutions and brand overrides match the prior snapshot.","risk":"Consumers with independent caches need coordinated version switching."}],"abstention_reason":""}
